info.brief: The base class of a GUI object: a part of a scene with its own hidden root box node, its
info.description:
The base class of a GUI object: a part of a scene with its own hidden root box node, its
own child objects, and the props and settings it is created with. A game subclasses it
with `extend`, assigns hooks to the subclass, and creates instances with a scene's or
another object's `new_object`.

elements.name: GuiObjectClass
types: GuiObject<P, S> & F & { 'new'(this: void): GuiObject<P, S> & F; }

elements.name: __name
elements.brief: The class name, the value `register_modal` reads to tell a class from a plain table.
elements.description: The class name, the value `register_modal` reads to tell a class from a plain table.

elements.name: new
elements.brief: Returns a new, not yet set up instance of the base class.
elements.description: Returns a new, not yet set up instance of the base class.

elements.name: extend
elements.brief: Returns a new subclass: a table indexing the base class, with its own `new`. Assign
elements.description:
Returns a new subclass: a table indexing the base class, with its own `new`. Assign
hooks such as `init` and `update` to it, and pass it to `new_object`. `P` and `S` type
the props and settings its instances are created with, and `F` the fields and methods
a game adds to it.

functions.name: setup
functions.brief: Sets the object up in a scene and runs `init`. `new_object` calls it on each new
functions.description:
Sets the object up in a scene and runs `init`. `new_object` calls it on each new
instance; a game does not.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.doc: The scene the object belongs to, under whose root `root` is created.

functions.name: is_alive
functions.brief: Returns whether the object is set up and not deleted: `nil` until `setup` has run
functions.description:
Returns whether the object is set up and not deleted: `nil` until `setup` has run
`init`, so also during `init`, then `true` until `delete` makes it `false`.

functions.name: new_box
functions.brief: Creates a box node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_box`.
functions.description: Creates a box node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_box`.

functions.name: new_text
functions.brief: Creates a text node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_text`.
functions.description: Creates a text node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_text`.

functions.name: new_pie
functions.brief: Creates a pie node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_pie`.
functions.description: Creates a pie node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_pie`.

functions.name: new_particlefx
functions.brief: Creates a particle fx node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_particlefx`.
functions.description: Creates a particle fx node under the object's root, from `wrap.node.Node.new_particlefx`.

functions.name: new_object
functions.brief: Creates a child object in the object's scene: calls the class's `new`, sets the
functions.description:
Creates a child object in the object's scene: calls the class's `new`, sets the
instance up with `setup`, which runs its `init`, and adds it to the objects
`bg_update`, `delete` and `bg_on_input` fan out to.

parameters.name: object_class
parameters.doc:
A class `extend` returns, whose props and settings may both be
omitted.

functions.name: new_object
functions.brief: Creates a child object whose class needs props, as the first form does.
functions.description: Creates a child object whose class needs props, as the first form does.

parameters.name: object_class
parameters.doc: A class `extend` returns, whose settings may be omitted.

functions.name: new_object
functions.brief: Creates a child object whose class needs settings, as the first form does.
functions.description: Creates a child object whose class needs settings, as the first form does.

parameters.name: props
parameters.doc: The child's props, or `undefined` for `{}` when the class allows it.

functions.name: init
functions.brief: Runs once `setup` has created `root`, from `new_object`. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs once `setup` has created `root`, from `new_object`. A no-op to replace.

functions.name: update
functions.brief: Runs each frame from `bg_update` while the object is alive. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs each frame from `bg_update` while the object is alive. A no-op to replace.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The time since the last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: final
functions.brief: Runs once from `delete`, before the child objects and `root` are deleted. A no-op to
functions.description:
Runs once from `delete`, before the child objects and `root` are deleted. A no-op to
replace.

functions.name: on_input
functions.brief: Runs from `bg_on_input` when no child object consumed the input. A no-op to replace.
functions.description: Runs from `bg_on_input` when no child object consumed the input. A no-op to replace.

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.doc: The input action's id, or `nil` for mouse movement.

returnvalues.doc: `true` to consume the input. The no-op returns `false`.

functions.name: bg_update
functions.brief: Runs `update`, then each child object's `update`, unless the object is not alive.
functions.description:
Runs `update`, then each child object's `update`, unless the object is not alive.
The scene calls it each frame. At this tag it calls a child's `update` rather than
its `bg_update`, so a child's own children are not updated.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The time since the last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: delete
functions.brief: Deletes the object, unless it is not alive: marks it deleted, runs `final`, deletes
functions.description:
Deletes the object, unless it is not alive: marks it deleted, runs `final`, deletes
each child object, then deletes `root` and the nodes under it.

functions.name: bg_on_input
functions.brief: Offers input to each child object's `bg_on_input`, the newest first, then to
functions.description:
Offers input to each child object's `bg_on_input`, the newest first, then to
`on_input` if none consumed it. Returns `false` when the object is not alive.

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.doc: The input action's id, or `nil` for mouse movement.

returnvalues.doc: Whether a child object or `on_input` consumed the input.
